sloka: एषा ऽल्पपुण्या कृपणा विनशिष्याम्यनाथवत् ।समुद्रमध्ये नौः पूर्णा वायुवेगैरिवाहता ।। ५.२५.१४।।।।
transliteration: eṣā 'lpapuṇyā kṛpaṇā vinaśiṣyāmyanāthavat ।samudramadhye nauḥ pūrṇā vāyuvegairivāhatā ।। 5.25.14।।।।

translations.english: 'I am a woman of low merit, a wretched woman, an orphan. I will be ruined like the loaded boat that gets hit in the midst of the ocean by the stormy wind.
